newsitem.title: POLAND: JVC EYES 5 PCT OF POLISH TV, RADIO MARKET.
newsitem.headline: JVC EYES 5 PCT OF POLISH TV, RADIO MARKET.

text.p: The Polish unit of JVC International wants to reach a five percent share of Poland's radio and television set market this year, the Polish unit's head, Kan'ichi Minami told a news conference on Wednedsay.

"Reaching five percent market share is JVC Poland's goal for the near future, but my real wish is to get it this year," Minami said, adding he wanted the Polish company's turnover to reach $40 million shortly.
JVC would invest in the development of a service and dealer network in Poland, he said, but did not give financial details.
Kenichi Hirasawa, deputy JVC manager general for Europe, also present, said his company was eyeing Poland as a production base, but it was not yet clear if it would build a factory here.
